boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Notre Dame
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops with directly verified current late availability in the Notre Dame–South Bend area.

cards.entity_name: Culver's of South Bend — Notre Dame
cards.title: Culver's of South Bend — Notre Dame
cards.subtitle: 52733 SR 933, South Bend
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm the midnight close before heading out; it lists lobby, curbside, and drive-thru service daily.
cards.short_summary: A north-side counter-service stop with service listed through midnight every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Culver's lists this 52733 SR 933 location's lobby, curbside, and drive-thru hours as daily 10:00 AM–12:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Culver's of South Bend, IN — Notre Dame
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists lobby, curbside, and drive-thru open daily until 12:00 AM; check the page for changes.

cards.title: McDonald's on State Route 933
cards.subtitle: 52665 Indiana State Route 933, South Bend
cards.notes: Check the location page just before leaving, especially if using the drive-thru; both restaurant and drive-thru hours are published there.
cards.short_summary: A State Route 933 location with midnight listed for restaurant and drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours through 12:00 AM daily at 52665 Indiana State Route 933.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru service until 12:00 AM daily; verify same-day changes on the location page.

cards.entity_name: Chipotle Mexican Grill — 1251 N Eddy St
cards.title: Chipotle at Eddy Street Commons
cards.subtitle: 1251 N Eddy St, South Bend
cards.notes: Place an in-store pickup order or walk in before the published close; the official location page identifies it at Eddy Street and Angela Boulevard.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Eddy Street Commons restaurant listed open until 11 PM every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle lists restaurant hours of 10:45 AM–11:00 PM Monday through Sunday at 1251 N Eddy St.
cards.source_title: Chipotle Mexican Grill — 1251 N Eddy St
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours until 11:00 PM daily and says in-store pickup is available during store hours.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West LaSalle
cards.subtitle: 221 W LaSalle Ave, South Bend
cards.notes: For very late pickup, use the drive-thru rather than assuming dine-in is open; the official page separately lists drive-thru hours.
cards.short_summary: A downtown drive-thru option with service listed as late as 4 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 3:00 AM most days and 4:00 AM Friday and Saturday at 221 W LaSalle Ave.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru until 3:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 AM Friday–Saturday; dine-in hours differ.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Brick Road
cards.subtitle: 6225 Brick Rd, South Bend
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru schedule as the reliable late option, and confirm it on the official page before a late trip because dine-in timing is separate.
cards.short_summary: A Brick Road location whose drive-thru is listed until 4 AM on six nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru service until 4:00 AM Sunday through Friday and 1:00 AM Saturday at 6225 Brick Rd.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru until 4:00 AM Sunday–Friday and 1:00 AM Saturday; check current dine-in hours separately.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Western Avenue
cards.subtitle: 5131 W Western Avenue, South Bend
cards.notes: Treat this as a drive-thru or takeout stop and consult the official location page before departure; its listed late hours vary by day.
cards.short_summary: A Western Avenue location with drive-thru hours listed as late as 4 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours through 4:00 AM Thursday through Tuesday and 2:00 AM Wednesday at 5131 W Western Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru until 4:00 AM Thursday–Tuesday and 2:00 AM Wednesday; dine-in hours are separately posted.

cards.title: Memo's Mexican Eatery
cards.subtitle: 2712 W Western Ave, South Bend
cards.notes: Plan for the designated late-night service window Thursday through Sunday, then check the restaurant's own page for any temporary schedule changes.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican eatery whose official site advertises a Thursday–Sunday late-night window.
cards.evidence_claim: Memo's Mexican Eatery states that it is open late Thursday through Sunday from 9:30 PM to 3:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official site advertises late-night service Thursday–Sunday, 9:30 PM–3:00 AM; confirm before traveling.

cards.title: Manny's on East Colfax
cards.subtitle: 503 E Colfax Ave, South Bend
cards.notes: Go for food during the published kitchen hours and check the venue's official page before traveling, particularly on Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A South Bend restaurant with late food hours listed through midnight or 1 AM on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Manny's lists Thursday hours until 12:00 AM and Friday–Saturday hours until 1:00 AM at 503 E Colfax Ave.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Thursday until 12:00 AM and Friday–Saturday until 1:00 AM; verify food-service availability directly before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Hungry Howie's Pizza — 2035 E Ireland Rd
cards.title: Hungry Howie's on East Ireland Road
cards.subtitle: 2035 E Ireland Rd, South Bend
cards.notes: Use the official store page to place a pickup or delivery order and recheck the listed midnight closing time before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A pizza delivery and takeout location currently listed open until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Hungry Howie's official store page for 2035 E Ireland Rd states that the location is open until 12:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official store page states it is open until 12:00 AM; use the page to confirm current pickup and delivery availability.

cards.title: Chipotle on IN-933
cards.subtitle: 52770 IN-933, South Bend
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm the 10 PM close and order options; it identifies this as a separate South Bend restaurant.
cards.short_summary: An IN-933 restaurant with daily hours posted through 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle lists restaurant hours of 10:45 AM–10:00 PM Monday through Sunday at 52770 IN-933.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists service until 10:00 PM daily and notes in-store pickup during store hours.
